transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer technical support, my name is Oliver. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Oliver. We have had a terrible disaster here. During the severe gale last night, a large tree branch snapped on our rural lane and has completely severed our overhead telephone drop wire! The wire is hanging down across the hedge and we have zero broadband or landline!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can report that physical cable damage to Openreach engineering, Gemma. Let me start with account verification. Can you confirm your full name and property address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Gemma Sinclair, The Old Forge, Mill Lane, Bakewell, DE45 1WT.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what I understand is that a fallen tree branch during last night's storm has physically severed the overhead drop cable supplying your property on Mill Lane, causing total loss of both broadband and landline services, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly it. The black wire is completely cut in two pieces, one end dangling from the wooden telegraph pole and the other in our driveway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the severed cable causing any immediate danger, such as sparking or obstructing highway traffic?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, it's a low-voltage telecom wire resting in the private driveway hedge, not across the main road.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of raising an emergency priority hazard ticket with the Openreach rural engineering dispatch team. Bear with me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Gemma. Openreach incident reference HR-88410 has been lodged with high priority for an external overhead line crew.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When can they actually come out to re-string the cable? We are completely isolated here without internet!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The earliest available emergency cherry-picker hoist team slot is booked for tomorrow, Thursday afternoon, between one PM and six PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tomorrow afternoon? What are we supposed to do until then? I have remote medical telemetry monitors that need data!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I said, overhead drop cables that span rural lanes require specialized two-man hoist teams for road safety compliance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there any way we can get emergency connectivity while we wait for the cherry picker?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. Do you have an active S-Net mobile phone in your household?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my personal smartphone is on an S-Net pay monthly SIM.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can provision an immediate Emergency Data Backup bundle of unlimited 4G and 5G data onto your S-Net SIM card right now, completely free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Also, does the severed wire have any tree branches resting on top of it currently in the driveway?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The main branch rolled into the ditch, but some smaller twigs are lying on the cable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please do not attempt to move or touch the cable directly, even though telecom lines are low voltage.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood, I've put a garden cone near the hedge so nobody walks over it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an excellent precaution.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, best to keep the delivery vans away from the driveway edge.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And has the weather calmed down in Bakewell today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the wind dropped this morning, just light rain now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, clear weather will allow the hoist crew to operate safely tomorrow afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fingers crossed the forecast holds up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We also automatically credit your bill for the days your fixed broadband is offline under our auto-compensation scheme.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's very fair, thank you for mentioning that.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I turn on personal hotspot so my laptop and the medical monitor can connect?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely. The unlimited bundle supports full Wi-Fi hotspot tethering with zero data caps.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be a lifesaver! What is my mobile number on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before I trigger the unlimited bundle, your mobile number is 07700 900384, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The unlimited emergency data pass has just been activated on the network switch. You will receive an SMS confirmation in about twenty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just got the text message: 'S-Net Emergency Data Pass active: Unlimited high-speed mobile data applied.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now turn on Personal Hotspot in your phone's settings, and connect your home devices to your phone's Wi-Fi network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Enabling Personal Hotspot now... Connecting laptop... Connected! Loading BBC News... It loaded instantly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you also connect the medical telemetry monitor to the hotspot to verify it establishes its secure data link?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Connecting the monitor... Green transmission light is solid! The vital telemetry data is syncing up!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms your household has stable, high-speed emergency internet while Openreach repairs the physical wire tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me enormous peace of mind. Thank you so much for setting that up Oliver.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Openreach will send you SMS tracking updates tomorrow morning when the line team is en route.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to be home for the engineer visit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, because they will need to test the connection at your internal master socket once the wire is spliced.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will make sure I'm home all afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your email address for the incident log, it's gemma dot sinclair at derbyshire dot org dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your emergency booking that I can assist you with today, Gemma?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Oliver, the emergency hotspot has completely saved the day. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Gemma, and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Oliver, goodbye.
